figures.title: A shared hidden cause
figures.alt: The three observed words share a latent topic. They are conditionally independent given that topic; the shared cause can make them marginally dependent.

figures.title: Separate density from communities
figures.alt: The constant matrix plus the signed community matrix gives the expected adjacency matrix plus p-star times identity, here p-star=0.4 and q-star=0.2. Subtract p-star times identity to restore the zero diagonal in the lecture’s model.
